service.method: SELECT CASE WHEN VUSER.CMP_ID = '12' THEN '1000' END AS COMPANY_CODE, UPPER(VUSER.USER_ID) AS USER_ID, VUSER.POS_CD AS POSITION, VUSER.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME_LOC, VUSER.EMP_NO AS EMPLOYEE_NO, CASE WHEN VUSER.EMP_STATUS = 'W' THEN 'N' WHEN VUSER.EMP_STATUS = 'R' THEN 'Y' END AS DEL_FLAG, VUSER.CMP_EMAIL, VUSER.REPRESENT_EMAIL AS EMAIL, VUSER.PROFILE_URL, VUSER.UPDATE_DATE, VUSER.USER_NAME_EN, VUSER.USER_NAME_CN, VUSER.CELL_PHONE AS PHONE, VUSER.FAX_NO, VUSER.CMP_PHONE, VUSER.LXTN_NO, VUSER.CHRG_WORK, VUSER.LOCATION, VUSER.RETIRE_DATE, VUSER.JOB_NAME, VJOB.DEPT_ID AS DEPT, VJOB.OFC_CD AS RESPONSIBILITY FROM V_MP_ORG_USER VUSER INNER JOIN V_MP_MY_JOB VJOB ON VUSER.CMP_ID = VJOB.CMP_ID AND VUSER.EMP_NO = VJOB.EMP_NO WHERE VUSER.CMP_ID = '12'

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , BIZ_CODE , SEQ , USER_ID , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , USER_NAME , EMAIL , PHONE_NO , IF_FLAG FROM SBUPI WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BIZ_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE}
